products.name: Stork RD-4 Screen Head Ring 64R Assembly
products.short_description: High precision 64R rotary screen head ring for Stork RD-4 rotary machines.
products.description: Manufactured from high-grade aircraft aluminium alloy ensuring strict concentricity, minimal runout, and long operating life under continuous printing pressure.
products.specifications: Repeat: 640mm (64R) | Concentricity: <0.015mm | Finish: Hard Anodized | Weight: 4.8kg

products.name: Main Drive Repeat Spur Gear 64R (Module 3)
products.short_description: Precision ground repeat gear for synchronized rotary printing drive transmission.
products.description: Case-hardened steel repeat gear with induction-hardened teeth providing maximum wear resistance in harsh print house environments.
products.specifications: Module: 3 | Teeth: 64 | Bore: 45mm H7 | Hardness: HRC 58-62

products.name: Stainless Steel Color Pump 1-Inch
products.short_description: Pneumatic diaphragm color pump for viscous dye and pigment paste transfer.
products.description: Corrosion resistant SS-316 body color feed pump designed for rotary printing machine print paste feed systems.
products.specifications: Inlet/Outlet: 1" BSP | Flow Rate: 45 L/min | Max Air Pressure: 7 Bar | Diaphragm: PTFE

products.name: Squeegee Blade Coil 0.20mm x 50mm
products.short_description: Imported Swedish stainless steel doctor squeegee blade coil.
products.description: Precision ground edge doctor blade providing uniform color paste penetration across wide printing widths.
products.specifications: Thickness: 0.20mm | Width: 50mm | Coil Length: 100 meters | Straightness: 0.1mm/m

products.name: Heavy Duty Sealed Bearing Unit 6008-2RS
products.short_description: Deep groove sealed ball bearing for rotary machine head assemblies.
products.description: High temperature grease packed bearing with dual rubber seals protecting against dye ingress and corrosion.
products.specifications: ID: 40mm | OD: 68mm | Width: 15mm | Dynamic Load: 17.8 kN

products.name: Stormac Rotary Printing Screen Head Drive Assembly
products.short_description: High precision screen head drive ring assembly for Stormac rotary screen printing machines.
products.description: Engineered to exact OEM tolerances for Stormac rotary printing machines. Minimizes radial runout to under 0.015mm, guaranteeing sharp color print registration at high textile production line speeds.
products.specifications: Bore: Standard Stormac | Repeat: 640mm / 819mm | Hard Anodized Wear Coating

products.name: Stormac Rotary Printing Machine Repeat Gear 64R
products.short_description: Precision ground repeat spur gear 64R for Stormac textile rotary printing drive sync.
products.description: Precision CNC profile ground repeat gear specifically manufactured for Stormac rotary screen printing heads. Case-hardened teeth provide superior resistance against tooth pitting and backlash under continuous multi-shift operations.
products.specifications: Teeth: 64 | Pitch / Module: Standard Stormac RD-IV | Hardness: HRC 58-62

products.name: Laxmi Rotary Printing Screen Head Ring Assembly 64R
products.short_description: Heavy-duty 64R screen head ring assembly for Laxmi rotary screen printing machines.
products.description: Heavy duty replacement screen head ring assembly manufactured for Laxmi rotary printing machines widely used across Surat and Ahmedabad process houses. Strict dynamic balance ensures zero vibration and consistent ink penetration.
products.specifications: Repeat: 64R / 81.9R / 91.4R | Compatibility: Laxmi Rotary Machines | Concentricity: <0.02mm

products.name: Laxmi Rotary Printing Squeegee Holder & Doctor Blade Unit
products.short_description: Precision squeegee blade holder and pressure adjustment bracket for Laxmi rotary printers.
products.description: Rigid squeegee beam blade clamping unit designed for Laxmi rotary screen printing machines. Allows micro-metric angle adjustment and uniform doctor blade contact across the entire screen length.
products.specifications: Length: Up to 3400mm | Blade Capacity: 0.15mm to 0.25mm blade coil | Clamping: Quick lock

products.name: Laxmi Rotary Screen Printing Pneumatic Color Pump System
products.short_description: High viscosity dye and paste transfer color pump for Laxmi rotary printing machines.
products.description: Heavy duty pneumatic double diaphragm color pump designed for transferring viscous pigment and reactive printing pastes on Laxmi rotary machines. Non-clogging design ensures steady paste flow.
products.specifications: Flow: 50 Liters/min | Ports: 1 Inch BSP | Max Pressure: 8 Bar | Air Operated

products.short_description: Pin Sensor for Laxmi rotary printing machine
